get.summary: Gets all available for Internet viewing Matter Attachments for one Matter record.

parameters.name: Client
parameters.description: The code of the Client database to connect to.

parameters.name: MatterId
parameters.description: The MatterId of the Matter.

post.description:
To upload an attachment file, it can either be provided as MatterAttachmentBinary (base64 encoded) with a MatterAttachmentFileName including
a file extension or by specifying a MatterAttachmentHyperlink and setting MatterAttachmentIsHyperlink to false.  This second method will
download the URL and save it as a local file.

parameters.name: Client
parameters.description: The code of the Client database to connect to.

parameters.name: MatterId
parameters.description: The MatterId of the Matter.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: GranicusMatterAttachment object to be inserted. Note that MatterAttachmentId is not required to be set. MatterAttachmentSort is auto-generated and should not be set.

To upload an attachment file, it can either be provided as MatterAttachmentBinary (base64 encoded) or by specifying a MatterAttachmentHyperlink
and setting MatterAttachmentIsHyperlink to false.  This second method will download the URL and save it as a local file.
Metadata updates can be done without reuploading the file content - just omit the MatterAttachmentBinary and MatterAttachmentHyperlink fields in the PUT.
